messages:
harper: quick follow-up from today's all-hands  want to collate the hiring/org questions we heard
naveen: topline: no blanket hiring freeze. we are redirecting new headcount to high-impact infra: runtime kernel work, Dedicated capacity, and SRE reliability for customer SLAs.
claire: will product-facing roles (SEs, PMs) be affected or moved under GTM?
naveen: SEs supporting named accounts will align to a single GTM lead for consistency, but day-to-day pairing with Product remains. PMs stay with Product org unless explicitly mapped.
harper: timeline for moves and org chart?
otis: org map v1 drops tomorrow AM. most reporting changes take effect at next pay period (two weeks). managers get mapping csv today.
claire: internal mobility window timing and rules?
people-bot: Mobility window: Aug 8 - Aug 12. Apply via portal: https://intranet.redwood.com/mobility :link:
naveen: you can apply without manager sign-off but please give a heads-up. interviews during the window get scheduling priority.
harper: what happens to open reqs that aren't in prioritized pillars?
otis: recruiting will review each req. prioritized-pillar reqs stay funded. noncritical reqs may be paused; recruiting will message hiring managers with status by EOD.
claire: if someone moves teams, how do we handle backfills for critical roles?
otis: critical customer-impact roles are fast-tracked. file a 'critical-backfill' note in #hq-hiring with a 2-line impact statement; aim is 72hr review.
harper: leveling and compensation concerns for transfers?
cto: leveling won't be downgraded automatically. materially changed roles trigger fast-track calibration. compensation adjustments considered for increased scope; standard promotion cycle still applies.
claire: will on-call or rotation expectations change for teams that lose staff?
otis: no global on-call increase. we'll rebalance rosters and provide temporary coverage if a team's pager load increases by >20%.
harper: will this affect Dedicated capacity roadmap or presets in Redwood Optimize recommendations?
cto: Dedicated roadmap protected; optimizer tuning budgets for cost/latency will remain prioritized for production workloads. any changes communicated via product channel.
people-bot: Follow-up doc: https://intranet.redwood.com/all-hands/aug-reorg-summary :link: :memo:
harper: thanks everyone. i'll compile these notes and post the follow-up doc with open items and owners.
